title: Extra holding time is not physical programme reuse
statement: For the stated newest-only SWAP-sector conveyor with arbitrary known memory and initially entangled known programme inputs, complete trace commutes back to each old output’s last physical use. On U=V tensor I_r, all-A prefixes leave only one actual V-query programme plus the final fresh call. With the stated conservative primary two-query upper beta=4/5, the accepted first-cross estimate gives Haar-V average Fe<=4/5+sqrt(m-1)/r. Uniform half-diamond error epsilon<1/5 requires m-1>=r²(1/5-epsilon)². This is not the later genuinely reused-P1 circuit or a general three-carrier lower bound.

The native subfamily U=V tensor I_r and the admitted conservative primary two-query unitary upper 4/5 at that exact terminal port
